'''Fiery Fornax rings''' were a [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] dish served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex" /> prior to its destruction during the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign.<ref name="DexEra">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' states that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the novel around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was [[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Dex's Diner was destroyed in either 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] or 18 BBY.</ref> They could be purchased at the diner for 3.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as a lunch side.<ref name="Dex" /> Fiery Fornax rings shared their name with [[Fornax/Legends|Fornax]], a planet in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was surrounded by the [[Fire Rings of Fornax]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There's more on the menu at Dex's Diner than Jawa juice&mdash;from sides (fiery Fornax rings) to dessert (wasaka berry pie) and everything in between, there's something for everyone at Coco Town's most popular greasy spoon.|Original pitch for "Dining at Dex's"|<ref name="Blog" />}}
Fiery Fornax rings were introduced in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" /> They were included in Walker's original pitch for the article.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>
